body.prompt: Dusk on the same dirt village road: the same grandpa from the reference images still stands at the road's end, now a small lonely figure, hands behind his back, gazing toward the hills where the car went. The magpie has landed on his shoulder and leans its head against his cheek; he smiles gently. A warm light glows from his house window behind the persimmon tree. Purple-orange sky, first evening lights. The magpie is exactly the character in the magpie reference image: a small round chibi magpie with a glossy black head, cream-white face and belly, big shiny dark-brown eyes, short black beak, dark navy-blue wings, a red knotted neckerchief and a small brown leather satchel. It does NOT hold a microphone. It is small, about the size of a sparrow compared with the people. Style: handcrafted 3D miniature diorama photographed with a macro lens, tilt-shift, shallow depth of field, soft cinematic light, felt, clay, paper and wood textures with tiny hand-painted details, gentle film grain, warm nostalgic color grade, clay figurines with soft rounded faces and deeply emotional Pixar-like expressions, not photorealistic. Vertical 9:16 frame, main subject in the middle of the frame, a calm uncluttered area in the top fifth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no hangul, no logos, no labels, no brand names, no watermark anywhere.
